Compatibility changes (not verbatim upstream behavior):
- The fixed harness identity names the real Pi Win7 Web runtime rather than
  claiming that the application is running DeepSeek Harness.
- Tool names read/write/edit/grep/skill map to read_file/write_file/edit_file/
  search_files/read_skill. read offset/limit map to startLine/maxLines.
- Remove shell comparisons from read/grep guidance. No Bash or PowerShell tools
  are added. The server must append its actual no-shell and permission policy to
  every selected persona and custom SYSTEM.md.
- Remove claims that the DSH fs-observation-policy enforces read-before-write;
  the behavior remains model guidance, while actual execution uses this app's
  permission wrapper and local tool implementation.
- Emit each guidance section only when the mapped tool is actually available.
- The minimal persona retains its one-sentence complete-prompt text, but the
  application's tools/permission policy are preserved. Its upstream persistent
  shell composition is NOT available or enabled.
- PTC and Cordis are catalogued as unavailable because their corresponding
  run_code / dynamic-plugin runtime has not been ported. Switching to either is
  rejected, rather than falsely advertising their original tools.

These four upstream entries are agent compositions/presets. They are not a
user-facing library of task templates. examples/prompts and Pi .pi/prompts
support are separate adapter/Pi features, not original DSH preset prompts.
